9.name: hesitates at the door
9.description: Asha stops at the top step with her hand raised to the door, then lets it fall as she reconsiders what she is about to do.
evidence: On the top step Asha stopped with her knuckles an inch from the door and let her hand fall.

9.name: decides to demand a signature tonight
9.description: Asha realizes she has shifted from planning to explain the filing to deciding she will make him sign it immediately so it can be docketed before Whitfield sees the Monday packet.
evidence: she had already decided something narrower and worse: she was going to ring the bell, and she was going to hand him a filing with his name in the signature block, and she was going to ask him to sign it tonight so it could be docketed as a correction before Whitfield read his Monday packet.

9.name: rings the bell
9.description: Asha presses the doorbell before she can talk herself out of the decision.
evidence: She pressed the bell before the part of her that had spent two years teaching him could talk her out of it.

9.name: hears movement inside
9.description: Asha notices someone moving upstairs as the bell sounds deeper inside the house than she expected.
evidence: The light in the second-floor window shifted as someone moved across it.
The bell sounded farther inside than she expected, a flat two-note chime through the door

9.name: grips the briefcase
9.description: Asha tightens her hold on the briefcase containing the papers she has brought.
evidence: Asha let her hand drop back to the briefcase handle. She tightened her grip on it, the leather still faintly warm from the car heater

9.name: checks Rosa's message
9.description: Asha receives and reads a text from Rosa telling her that he is moving and to go in without coaching.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once against her hip, and she already knew before she looked: Rosa, three short lines. He's moving. Go in. No coaching. Just the page.
Asha read it once and slid the phone back into her coat pocket without answering

9.name: recognizes her true intention
9.description: Rosa's message forces Asha to admit to herself that she had been avoiding naming her real plan on the drive over.
evidence: because Rosa had named the thing she had been intending not to name to herself on the drive over

9.name: withholds answering Rosa's call
9.description: Asha puts her phone away without answering because Rosa has forced her to confront an unspoken realization.
evidence: the phone back into her coat pocket without answering
because Rosa had named the thing she had been intending not to name to herself on the drive over

9.name: anticipates Rosa's message
9.description: While waiting at the door, Asha imagines Rosa texting that the door is opening and that she should hand over the page without talking.
evidence: Her phone buzzed a second time against her hip while she was still listening for footsteps on the other side of the door.
Rosa would have written something short, the door is opening, hand him the page, no talking around it

9.name: prepares to confront Devin
9.description: Asha braces herself at the top step, grips her briefcase tightly, and focuses on the apartment door instead of the upstairs window.
evidence: Asha shifted her weight forward over the top step and tightened her grip on the briefcase handle until the leather creased under her thumb
keeping her eyes on the brass number above the peephole rather than the lit window upstairs

9.name: door opens to Devin
9.description: The locks are undone and the door opens partway, revealing Devin in the hallway doorway.
evidence: A bolt slid, then the deadbolt, and the door pulled inward a few inches into the warmer air of the hallway.
Devin filled the gap in the doorway

9.name: Devin silently assesses Asha
9.description: Devin appears in the doorway and studies Asha without speaking or masking his expression.
evidence: Devin filled the gap in the doorway in a sweatshirt with the sleeves pushed up, a dish towel still in one hand, and for a second he just looked at her without arranging his face.

9.name: Asha greets Devin and offers the page
9.description: Asha steps into the warm hallway air, meets Devin's eyes, and tells him she has brought the page.
evidence: Asha took a half step forward into the band of warm air coming out of the hallway, met his eyes, and said, "Hello, Devin. I brought you the page."

9.name: Asha speaks more steadily than expected
9.description: Asha notices that her voice sounds steadier than she expected as she addresses Devin.
evidence: She heard her own voice come out steadier than she'd expected

9.name: Asha greets Devin at the door
9.description: Asha arrives at Devin's apartment entrance and greets him while presenting the page she brought.
evidence: met his eyes, and said, "Hello, Devin. I brought you the page."

9.name: Devin silently lets Asha inside
9.description: Devin steps back from the threshold and gestures her into the apartment without speaking.
evidence: He stepped back from the threshold without answering and tipped his head toward the kitchen behind him, and she crossed in over the mat

9.name: Asha enters feeling she must be more honest
9.description: As she goes inside, Asha realizes her next words will need to be more honest than her greeting.
evidence: aware that the next thing she said in his apartment would have to be more honest than the first

9.name: Asha and Devin face each other in the kitchen
9.description: Inside the narrow kitchen, Devin clears space and waits while Asha prepares to hand over the corrected filing.
evidence: The kitchen was narrower than she'd pictured, a galley with a small square table pushed against the wall under a hanging lamp, two mismatched chairs, a half-folded laundry basket on one of them.
Devin moved the basket onto the counter without a word and dropped the dish towel beside the sink, then stood with his hands at his sides, waiting.

9.name: Asha delays while opening the briefcase
9.description: Asha sets down her briefcase and slowly opens it, resisting the urge to talk while her hands are occupied.
evidence: Asha set the briefcase flat on the table and worked the latches one at a time, slower than she needed to, because she could feel herself wanting to talk while her hands were busy and she had decided in the car not to do that.

9.name: Asha presents the corrected filing
9.description: Asha removes the corrected filing from the briefcase and places it on the table between them with Devin's name visible.
evidence: She lifted the corrected filing out by its edges and laid it on the table between them, the signature block turned so he could read his own name where hers would normally have been.

9.name: Asha hesitates after placing the page
9.description: Asha keeps her fingers on the page briefly, signaling reluctance or the need to say more before withdrawing.
evidence: She kept her fingers on the top corner of the page for a moment after it was down, then drew her hand bac

9.name: reveals signature block to him
9.description: The page is turned so Devin can read his own name where hers would normally be on the signature block.
evidence: the signature block turned so he could read his own name where hers would normally have been

9.name: withdraws hand from page
9.description: Asha keeps her fingers on the page briefly, then pulls her hand away and looks at Devin.
evidence: She kept her fingers on the top corner of the page for a moment after it was down, then drew her hand back and looked at him
Asha drew her fingers fully off the page and let her hand fall to her side, keeping her eyes on Devin

9.name: withholds further prompting
9.description: Asha refuses to soften the moment by offering the pen or any additional framing.
evidence: she was not going to dress them up by arranging the props
she did not slide the pen toward him or offer any further framing

9.name: holds steady under his gaze
9.description: Asha stays still and does not soften herself while Devin looks at her.
evidence: Devin looked down at the page, then back at her, and she made herself stand still inside that look rather than soften it for either of them

9.name: leaves silence for Devin
9.description: Asha remains motionless and silent while Devin continues to hesitate over the page.
evidence: Asha did not move
She kept her hand at her side and her eyes on Devin
Devin's gaze went down to the signature block and stayed there longer than the second look had

9.name: recognizes her influence would decide for him
9.description: Asha realizes that any small helpful gesture now would amount to choosing for Devin, which she has already begun to do.
evidence: Asha understood, standing inside that silence, that any small helpful thing she did now—clearing her throat, naming the deadline again, sliding the pen—would be a way of choosing for him, and she had already u

9.name: withhold helpful intervention
9.description: Asha realizes that even small gestures like clearing her throat or naming the deadline would be another way of choosing for Devin, so she restrains herself.
evidence: any small helpful thing she did now—clearing her throat, naming the deadline again, sliding the pen—would be a way of choosing for him, and she had already used up her allowance of choosing for him in the car on the way over.

9.name: hold position beside the table
9.description: Asha stays still at the table, keeping her hand at her side and her eyes on Devin instead of moving or blinking away.
evidence: Asha held where she was.

Her hand stayed at her side, her eyes on Devin, and she did not let herself blink the look away or shift her weight against the table edge to ease the ache that had settled into her lower back somewhere on the drive over.

9.name: leave pen within Devin's reach
9.description: Asha leaves the pen near the briefcase on her side of the table, forcing Devin to reach across the page if he wants it.
evidence: The pen lay where she had set it down, near the briefcase, closer to her side of the table than to his, and she did not correct that either; whatever he reached for, he would have to reach across the page to do it.

9.name: release held breath
9.description: Asha exhales and lets her shoulders drop slightly, but she still refuses to fill the silence.
evidence: Asha let out a breath she had not realized she was holding so tight, and her shoulders dropped a quarter inch against the line of her jacket.
She kept her eyes on Devin and did not fill the space the breath had opened.

9.name: wait for Devin to move first
9.description: Asha watches Devin struggle with the silence and deliberately waits for him to make the first move.
evidence: The small muscle at his jaw tightened again and stayed tightened this time, and she watched him watch the page, the corner of the filing where his name would go catching the lamp at an angle that made the blank line look longer than it was.
She waited inside the quiet and let him be the one who had to move first.

9.name: remain motionless in silence
9.description: Asha continues to hold still and watch Devin as the scene ends mid-thought.
evidence: Asha kept her eyes on Devin and did not move. She le

9.name: withholds response in silence
9.description: She stays quiet and lets the silence stretch, forcing him to be the first to move.
evidence: She waited inside the quiet and let him be the one who had to move first.

9.name: holds eye contact without moving
9.description: Asha keeps her eyes on Devin and remains physically still, signaling deliberate restraint.
evidence: Asha kept her eyes on Devin and did not move.

9.name: extends silence beyond kindness
9.description: Asha deliberately lets the silence continue past the point where she would normally soften it, revealing a harder edge than usual.
evidence: She let the silence go on past the point where she would normally have softened it, past the point where the kindness she had spent two years building with him would have asked her to speak.

9.name: leaves corrected page unadjusted
9.description: The corrected page remains between them, and Asha refuses to alter the language or fill in the blank line.
evidence: The page lay between them in the lamp's circle, the corrected language stark above the blank line, and she did not adjust it.

9.name: hears movement overhead
9.description: A footstep passes above the ceiling and disappears, adding a brief external interruption to the tense standoff.
evidence: Somewhere above the ceiling a footstep crossed and was gone

9.name: Devin shifts hand slightly
9.description: Devin's hand lifts a fraction from the table edge and settles again, showing restrained hesitation.
evidence: Devin's hand, which had been flat against the table edge, lifted half an inch and settled again.
